text: a man full of talk: Heb. a man of lips
as high as heaven: Heb. the heights of heaven
cut off: Or, make a change | who can hinder him? Heb. who can turn him away?
shall be clearer than the noon day: Heb. shall arise above the noonday
make suit unto thee: Heb. intreat thy face
they shall not escape: Heb. flight shall perish from them | giving up of the ghost: Or, a puff of breath
